description: Pilot skill-trigger eval set across frontmatter-strengthened SciTeX packages. Each case simulates a realistic user query and checks whether the expected package's SKILL.md is auto-loaded by Claude Code.

evals.query: I have a directory of CSV files I want to load all at once into a dict keyed by filename. What's the simplest way?
I just made a matplotlib figure and I want to save it as PNG, but also get a CSV export of the underlying data automatically. Is there a one-liner?
Run an independent-samples t-test between two numpy arrays and give me a publication-ready result with effect size, CI, and normality check.
Add a new BibTeX entry to my manuscript project for DOI 10.1038/s41586-021-03819-2.
Search for recent papers on 'phase-amplitude coupling in hippocampus' and download the PDFs to a new project.
I re-ran an analysis script and want to verify every input/output hash still matches what I tracked before. How do I check provenance integrity?
Plot a raster/event plot from a list of spike-time arrays, publication-ready.
Speak this text aloud using text-to-speech with an offline backend, no network needed.
Fetch a specific BIDS dataset from OpenNeuro by accession number.
I want to seed numpy, Python random, and PyTorch all at once for a reproducible experiment. Is there a one-call helper?
Inside a script, find the git root directory by walking up from the current file.
Render a LaTeX string as a matplotlib label, but fall back to mathtext or unicode if there's no LaTeX install on the system.
Build an Apptainer SIF image from my .def recipe and tag it with a new version.
The container I just switched to is broken. How do I roll back to the previous version?
Capture a full environment snapshot — container version, pip freeze, conda env, apt packages, git commits — for a reproducibility record attached to a paper claim.
Set up a persistent reverse SSH tunnel through a bastion host so I can reach this NAT-ed lab machine from outside.
Send me a desktop alert when this long-running training job finishes, with audio fallback if desktop notifications don't work.
Call my phone via Twilio if the server goes down.
Inspect the computed width, flex, and CSS rules of #ws-worktree-resizer in my live playwright browser so I can debug why it's not resizing.
Scaffold a new SciTeX workspace app called 'viewer_app' with a React frontend.
Lint this SciTeX Python project for convention violations — CONFIGS naming, stx.io.save usage, matplotlib prefs, all the ecosystem rules.
Verify this Jupyter notebook runs top-to-bottom without errors before I commit it.
Submit my test suite to SLURM and poll for results without blocking.
How do I write a list comprehension that filters out None values?
How do I list files in a directory sorted by modification time on Linux?
